question: After the keyboard defect and current-head proof gap are resolved, should this moving integrations rail and broader homepage treatment replace the existing homepage direction?
rationale: Correctness review can require accessible focus behavior, but automated review cannot decide whether this unfinished broad visual direction is the preferred permanent homepage composition.

options.title: Continue the refreshed direction
options.body: Retain the proposed visual composition, repair the focus model, and finish responsive and theme validation before marking the PR ready.

options.title: Narrow the facelift
options.body: Keep selected section and token improvements but replace the moving rail or other high-complexity interactions with simpler established homepage patterns.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Leave the current homepage in place until a smaller or more fully proven visual proposal is ready.

recommendation.title: Continue the refreshed direction
recommendation.body: Retain the proposed visual composition, repair the focus model, and finish responsive and theme validation before marking the PR ready.

likelyOwner.reason: The current homepage architecture and most recent visual language originate from their merged work, making them the strongest history-based routing candidate for design-direction review.
